evidence.pali: ‘‘Katamañca, bhikkhave, samādhindriyaṃ? Idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako vossaggārammaṇaṃ karitvā labhati samādhiṃ, labhati cittassa ekaggataṃ. So vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti ‘upekkhako satimā sukhavihārī’ti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, samādhindriyaṃ.
evidence.chinese_simplified: 诸位比丘，什么是定根？诸位比丘，于此，圣弟子以涅槃为所缘而得定，得心一境性。他远离诸欲，远离诸不善法，有寻有伺，具足并安住于由远离所生的喜、乐的初禅。寻、伺寂灭故，内得净信，心专一性，无寻无伺，具足并安住于由定所生的喜、乐的第二禅。又因离喜，他住于舍，具念、正知，以身感受乐，具足并安住于第三禅，对此，圣者们宣说：‘舍者，具念，乐住。’舍乐、舍苦故，以及先前喜、忧已灭没故，不苦不乐，舍念清净，具足并安住于第四禅。诸位比丘，这被称为定根。
evidence.english: “And what, Bhikkhus, is the faculty of concentration? Here, Bhikkhus, a noble disciple, making relinquishment his object, attains concentration, attains one-pointedness of mind. He, secluded from sensual pleasures, secluded from unwholesome states, enters and dwells in the first jhāna, which is accompanied by applied and sustained thought, with rapture and happiness born of seclusion. With the stilling of applied and sustained thought, he enters and dwells in the second jhāna, which has internal confidence and unification of mind, is without applied and sustained thought, and has rapture and happiness born of concentration. With the fading away of rapture, he dwells equanimous, mindful, and clearly comprehending, and experiences happiness with the body; he enters and dwells in the third jhāna, of which the noble ones declare: 'Equanimous and mindful, he dwells happily.' With the abandoning of happiness and pain, and with the previous disappearance of joy and displeasure, he enters and dwells in the fourth jhāna, which is neither painful nor pleasant and has the purification of mindfulness through equanimity. This, Bhikkhus, is called the faculty of concentration.”

entries.pali: Ārammaṇe cittaṃ sammā adhiyati ṭhapetīti samādhi. Sova vikkhepassa abhibhavanato adhipatiyaṭṭhena indriyaṃ. Avikkhepalakkhaṇe vā indaṭṭhaṃ kāretīti indriyaṃ. Samādhiyeva indriyaṃ samādhindriyaṃ . Lakkhaṇādīni panassa heṭṭhā vuttanayeneva veditabbāni.
entries.chinese_simplified: 能善巧地将心置于所缘，故为定（samādhi）。彼定因能压伏散乱，以主导义故为根（indriya）。或于不散乱相中行使主导作用，故为根。定即是根，是为定根（samādhindriya）。又，其相、作用等，当依前方已说之法而了知。
entries.english: Because it places the mind well on an object, it is called concentration (samādhi). That very concentration, because it overcomes distraction, is a faculty in the sense of exercising supremacy. Alternatively, because in the characteristic of non-distraction it causes its own state of sovereignty to be exercised, it is a faculty. Concentration itself is the faculty, the faculty of concentration. Its characteristics and so on should be known in the manner already stated below.

entries.pali: Samādhi pana jhānaṅgāni patvā cittassekaggatā hotīti vutto, indriyāni patvā samādhindriyanti, maggaṅgāni patvā sammāsamādhīti. Balāni patvā samādhibalanti, piṭṭhidukaṃ patvā samatho avikkhepoti. Evamayaṃ eko dhammo chasu ṭhānesu vibhatto.
entries.chinese_simplified: 再者，定(samādhi)于禅支中，被称为心一境性(cittassekaggatā)；于诸根中，被称为定根；于道支中，被称为正定(sammāsamādhi)；于诸力中，被称为定力；于背二法(piṭṭhiduka)中，被称为止(samatha)与不散乱(avikkhepa)。如此，此一法于六处被分别。
entries.english: Furthermore, concentration, having reached the absorption factors, is spoken of as 'one-pointedness of mind'; having reached the faculties, as the 'faculty of concentration'; having reached the path factors, as 'Right Concentration'; having reached the powers, as the 'power of concentration'; and having reached the pair of backing states, as 'calm' and 'non-distraction'. Thus, this one state is divided into six instances.

entries.pali: Samatho ti tividho samatho – cittasamatho, adhikaraṇasamatho, sabbasaṅkhārasamathoti. Tattha aṭṭhasu samāpattīsu cittekaggatā cittasamatho nāma. Tañhi āgamma cittacalanaṃ cittavipphanditaṃ sammati vūpasammati, tasmā so cittasamatho ti vuccati. Sammukhāvinayādisattavidho samatho adhikaraṇasamatho nāma. Tañhi āgamma tāni tāni adhikaraṇāni sammanti vūpasammanti, tasmā so adhikaraṇasamatho ti vuccati. Yasmā pana sabbe saṅkhārā nibbānaṃ āgamma sammanti vūpasammanti, tasmā taṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho ti vuccati. Imasmiṃ atthe cittasamatho adhippeto. Samādhilakkhaṇe indaṭṭhaṃ kāretīti samādhindriyaṃ . Uddhacce na kampatīti samādhibalaṃ. Sammāsamādhī ti yāthāvasamādhi niyyānikasamādhi kusalasamādhi.
entries.chinese_simplified: 寂静有三种：心寂静、灭诤法、一切行寂静。其中，八种等至中的心一境性称为心寂静。因为依止它，心的动摇、心的散乱得以平息、止息，因此称为心寂静。以现前毘尼(sammukhāvinaya)等七种寂静，称为灭诤法。因为依止它，种种争端得以平息、止息，因此称为灭诤法。又因为一切行依于涅槃而平息、止息，因此涅槃称为一切行寂静。于此义中，意指心寂静。于定相中行使主导作用，故为定根。不为掉举所动摇，故为定力。正定即如实定、出离定、善定。
entries.english: Samatha (tranquility) is of three kinds: tranquility of mind, settlement of disputes, and calming of all formations. Herein, the one-pointedness of mind in the eight attainments is called tranquility of mind. For by resorting to it, the agitation and oscillation of the mind are calmed and especially calmed; therefore, it is called tranquility of mind. The sevenfold samatha beginning with settlement in the presence (sammukhāvinaya) is called settlement of disputes. For by resorting to it, those various disputes are settled and especially settled; therefore, it is called settlement of disputes. Furthermore, because all formations are calmed and especially calmed upon reaching Nibbāna, that Nibbāna is called the calming of all formations. In this context, tranquility of mind is intended. It is the faculty of concentration (samādhindriya) because it exercises sovereignty in the characteristic of concentration. It is the power of concentration (samādhibalaṃ) because it is not shaken by restlessness. Right concentration is concentration as it actually is, concentration leading to deliverance, and wholesome concentration.

entries.pali: Katthaci dve ti ‘‘dvinnaṃ kho, bhikkhave, indriyānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu aññaṃ byākaroti…pe… ariyāya ca paññāya ariyāya ca vimuttiyā. Yā hissa, bhikkhave, ariyā paññā, tadassa paññindriyaṃ. Yā hissa ariyā vimutti, tadassa samādhindriya’’ntiādīsu (saṃ. ni. 5.516) dve, ‘‘tiṇṇaṃ kho, bhikkhave, indriyānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā piṇḍolabhāradvājena bhikkhunā aññā byākatā…pe… satindriyassa samādhindriyassa paññindriyassā’’ti (saṃ. ni. 5.519), ‘‘tīṇimāni, bhikkhave, indriyāni. Katamāni tīṇi? Anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ aññindriyaṃ aññātāvindriya’’nti (saṃ. ni. 5.493), ‘‘tīṇimāni…pe… itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriya’’nti (saṃ. ni. 5.492) ca evamādīsu tīṇi, ‘‘pañcimāni, brāhmaṇa, indriyāni nānāvisayāni…pe… cakkhundriyaṃ…pe… kāyindriya’’nti (saṃ. ni. 5.512), ‘‘pañci…pe… sukhindriyaṃ…pe… upekkhindriya’’nti (saṃ. ni. 5.501 ādayo), ‘‘pañci…pe… saddhindriyaṃ…pe… paññindriya’’nti (saṃ. ni. 5.486 ādayo) ca evamādīsu pañca. Tattha suttante dukādivacanaṃ nissaraṇupāyādibhāvato dukādīnaṃ. Sabbāni pana indriyāni abhiññeyyāni, abhiññeyyadhammadesanā ca abhidhammoti idha sabbāni ekato vuttāni.
entries.chinese_simplified: 在某些地方说二根，如：‘诸比丘，因修习、多修习此二根，漏尽比丘得以宣告证智……乃至……圣慧与圣解脱。诸比丘，其圣慧即是慧根，其圣解脱即是定根。’（《相应部》5.516）等是说二根。又如：‘诸比丘，因修习、多修习此三根，宾头卢颇罗堕比丘得以宣告证智……乃至……念根、定根、慧根。’（《相应部》5.519）；‘诸比丘，有此三根。是哪三根？未知当知根、已知根、具知根。’（《相应部》5.493）；‘有此三根……乃至……女根、男根、命根。’（《相应部》5.492）等，如此是说三根。又如：‘婆罗门，有此五根，所缘各异……乃至……眼根……乃至……身根。’（《相应部》5.512）；‘五根……乃至……乐根……乃至……舍根。’（《相应部》5.501等）；‘五根……乃至……信根……乃至……慧根。’（《相应部》5.486等），如此是说五根。于此，经中说二根等，是因二根等具有作为出离方便等特质。然而，一切根都应被遍知，而阐述应被遍知之法的即是阿毗达摩，因此在此将它们全部一并宣说。
entries.english: In some places, two are mentioned, as in: “Monks, it is through having developed and cultivated two faculties that a monk who is an arahant declares final knowledge… through noble wisdom and noble liberation. For him, monks, that noble wisdom is the faculty of wisdom. That noble liberation is the faculty of concentration,” and so on (SN 5.516). In other places, three are mentioned, as in: “Monks, it is through having developed and cultivated three faculties that the monk Piṇḍolabhāradvāja declared final knowledge… the faculty of mindfulness, the faculty of concentration, and the faculty of wisdom” (SN 5.519); and “Monks, there are these three faculties. Which three? The faculty of ‘I shall come to know the unknown,’ the faculty of final knowledge, and the faculty of one who has final knowledge” (SN 5.493); and “Monks, there are these three… the female faculty, the male faculty, and the life faculty” (SN 5.492). In other places, five are mentioned, as in: “Brahmin, there are these five faculties with different domains… the eye faculty… the body faculty” (SN 5.512); and “There are five… the faculty of pleasure… the faculty of equanimity” (SN 5.501); and “There are five… the faculty of faith… the faculty of wisdom” (SN 5.486). Therein, in the Suttas, the mention of pairs, triads, and so on is because these pairs, etc., are the means of escape, and so on. However, all faculties are to be directly known, and the teaching of phenomena to be directly known is the Abhidhamma; therefore, here all are stated together.

entries.pali: ‘‘Tattha hi ekanteneva saddhāsatipaññāyo natthi, samādhivīriyāni pana indriyappattāni na hontī’’ ti vuttaṃ, yadi pana samādhivīriyāni santi, ‘‘indriyappattāni na hontī’’ti na sakkā vattuṃ ‘‘samādhi samādhindriyanti? Āmantā’’ti (yama. 3.indriyayamaka.113) ‘‘vīriyaṃ vīriyindriyanti? Āmantā’’ti (yama. 3.indriyayamaka.111) vacanato. Ahetukapaṭisandhicitte ca yathā samādhileso ekaggatā atthi, na evaṃ vīriyaleso atthi, tasmā evamettha vattabbaṃ siyā ‘‘tattha hi ekanteneva saddhāvīriyasatipaññāyo natthi, ekaggatā pana samādhileso eva hotī’’ti. Ayaṃ panettha adhippāyo siyā – yathā aññesu kesuci ahetukacittesu samādhivīriyāni honti indriyappattāni ca, evamidha samādhivīriyāni indriyappattāni na hontīti. Samādhivīriyindriyānameva abhāvaṃ dassento ahetukantarato viseseti . Tattha ‘‘samādhivīriyāni pana na hontī’’ti vattabbe ‘‘indriyappattānī’’ti samādhilesassa samādhindriyabhāvaṃ appattassa sabbhāvato vuttaṃ, na vīriyalesassa. Visesanañhi visesitabbe pavattati. Yesu pana potthakesu ‘‘tattha ekanteneva saddhāvīriyasatipaññāyo natthī’’ti pāṭho, so eva sundarataro.
entries.chinese_simplified: 经言：‘于彼处，实则完全无信、念与慧，然定与精进未达根之程度。’若定与精进实有，则不能说‘未达根之程度’，依（《双论·根双论》113）‘定即定根耶？诚然。’及（《双论·根双论》111）‘精进即精进根耶？诚然。’故。于无因结生心中，如定之少分——心一境性存在，精进之少分则不存在。是故，于此应如是说：‘于彼处，实则完全无信、精进、念与慧，然有心一境性，仅为定之少分。’此中意趣或为：如于其他某些无因心中，定与精进存在且达根之程度，于此则定与精进未达根之程度。其通过与其他无因心的差别，显示了定根与精进根的阙如。于此，当言‘然定与精进不存在’时，反言‘未达根之程度’，是就‘定的少分未达定根’之存在而说，非就精进的少分而言。盖因简别语用于所应简别之处。然于某些典籍中，‘于彼处，实则完全无信、精进、念与慧’之读法，彼读法更善。
entries.english: It is stated: 'Here, there is absolutely no faith, mindfulness, or wisdom, and concentration and energy do not attain the status of faculties.' But if concentration and energy exist, it cannot be said that 'they do not attain the status of faculties,' according to the statements: 'Is concentration the faculty of concentration? Yes' (Yamaka 3, Indriyayamaka, 113), and 'Is energy the faculty of energy? Yes' (Yamaka 3, Indriyayamaka, 111). In the rootless rebirth-linking consciousness, just as there is a trace of concentration, namely one-pointedness, there is no such trace of energy. Therefore, it should be stated thus: 'Here, there is absolutely no faith, energy, mindfulness, or wisdom, but one-pointedness is indeed a trace of concentration.' Here, the intended meaning might be this: just as in some other rootless consciousnesses, concentration and energy exist and attain the status of faculties, so here, concentration and energy do not attain the status of faculties. By showing the absence of the faculties of concentration and energy, it distinguishes this from other rootless states. There, when it should be said 'but concentration and energy do not exist,' the phrase 'do not attain the status of faculties' is stated because of the existence of a trace of concentration that has not attained the status of the faculty of concentration, but not because of a trace of energy. For a qualification applies to what is qualified. However, in some books, the reading 'Here, there is absolutely no faith, energy, mindfulness, or wisdom' is found, and that is indeed more elegant.

entries.pali: Itarakiccabheda nti upaṭṭhānādikiccavisesaṃ. Passaddhādī ti ādi -saddena samādhiupekkhāsambojjhaṅgānaṃ saṅgaho daṭṭhabbo. Hāpetabba nti yathā saddhindriyassa balavabhāvo dhammasabhāvapaccavekkhaṇena hāyati, evaṃ vīriyindriyassa adhimattatā passaddhiādibhāvanāya hāyati samādhipakkhiyattā tassā. Tathā hi samādhindriyassa adhimattataṃ kosajjapātato rakkhantī vīriyādibhāvanā viya vīriyindriyassa adhimattataṃ uddhaccapātato rakkhantī ekaṃsato hāpeti. Tena vuttaṃ ‘‘passaddhaādibhāvanāya hāpetabba’’ nti. Soṇattherassa vatthū ti sukumārasoṇattherassa vatthu. (Mahāva. 242; a. ni. aṭṭha. 1.1.205) so hi āyasmā satthu santike kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā sītavane viharanto ‘‘mama sarīraṃ sukhumālaṃ, na ca sakkā sukheneva sukhaṃ adhigantuṃ, kilametvāpi samaṇadhammo kātabbo’’ti taṃ ṭhānacaṅkamameva adhiṭṭhāya padhānaṃ anuyuñjanto pādatalesu phoṭesu uṭṭhitesupi vedanaṃ ajjhupekkhitvā daḷhaṃ vīriyaṃ karonto accāraddhavīriyatāya visesaṃ nibbattetuṃ nāsakkhi. Satthā tattha gantvā vīṇūpamovādena ovaditvā vīriyasamatāyojanavīthiṃ dassento kammaṭṭhānaṃ sodhetvā gijjhakūṭaṃ gato. Theropi satthārā dinnanayena vīriyasamataṃ yojetvā bhāvento vipassanaṃ ussukkāpetvā arahatte patiṭṭhāsi. Tena vuttaṃ ‘‘soṇattherassa vatthu dassetabba’’ nti. Sesesupī ti satisamādhipaññindriyesupi.
entries.chinese_simplified: 其他作用的差别，是指现起等作用的差别。‘轻安等’中的‘等’字，应理解为包含定觉支与舍觉支。应减弱，是说正如信根的强盛通过省察法自性而减弱，精进根的过盛也因修习轻安等而减弱，因为后者属于定品。诚然，正如修习精进等能守护定根不过盛，免于堕入懈怠，修习轻安等也能守护精进根不过盛，免于堕入掉举，从而完全减弱它。因此说‘应通过修习轻安等来减弱’。苏那(Soṇa)长老的故事，即是关于娇贵的苏那长老的故事。这位具寿从世尊处领受业处后，住在寒林(Sītavana)时心想：‘我的身体娇贵，不能安逸地证得安乐，即便劳累也要修沙门法。’于是他唯以经行精进修行，即使脚底起泡，也漠视其苦受，勇猛精进，但因精进过头而未能证得殊胜境界。世尊前往彼处，以琴弦之喻教导他，开示了平衡精进的方法，清净其业处后返回鹫峰山(Gijjhakūṭa)。长老也依世尊所授之法，致力于精进的平衡，策励修观，最终安住于阿罗汉果。因此说‘应开示苏那长老的故事’。‘其余诸根也是如此’，是指念根、定根、慧根也是如此。
entries.english: The differentiation of other functions refers to specific duties such as presence of mind, and so forth. ‘Passaddhādīti’—by the word ‘etcetera,’ the inclusion of the enlightenment factors of concentration and equanimity should be understood. ‘Hāpetabbaṃ’—just as the strength of the faculty of faith is diminished through reflection on the nature of phenomena, so too is the excessiveness of the faculty of energy diminished through the development of tranquility and so forth, because tranquility belongs to the side of concentration. For just as the development of energy and so forth protects the excessiveness of the faculty of concentration from falling into laziness, in the same way, the development of tranquility and so forth, protecting the excessiveness of the faculty of energy from falling into restlessness, decidedly diminishes it. Hence it is said, ‘It should be diminished through the development of tranquility, etc.’ ‘The story of Soṇa Thera’—this is the story of the delicate Soṇa Thera. He, the venerable one, having received a meditation subject from the Teacher, dwelt in the Cool Grove, thinking, ‘My body is delicate, and it is not possible to attain happiness through happiness alone; even if it is exhausting, the ascetic's practice must be done.’ He resolved to practice walking meditation in that very spot and diligently applied himself to exertion. Though blisters arose on the soles of his feet, he endured the pain and exerted strong energy. However, due to excessive striving, he was unable to achieve any distinction. The Teacher went there and advised him with the simile of the lute, showing the path of balancing energy. After clarifying the meditation subject, he went to Vulture Peak. The elder, standing in the method given by the Teacher, applied balanced energy and, diligently developing insight, became established in arahantship. Hence it is said, ‘The story of Soṇa Thera should be shown.’ ‘In the remaining cases as well’—this applies also to the faculties of mindfulness, concentration, and wisdom.

entries.work_title: 阿毗达摩入门-名色分别 Abhidhammāvatāro-Nāmarūpaparicchedo
entries.pali: Pañcuttarasate citte, vīriyaṃ āha nāyako; Catuttarasate citte, samādhindriyamabravi.
entries.chinese_simplified: 导师说精进于一百零五心中生起；并言定根于一百零四心中生起。
entries.english: The Leader spoke of energy in one hundred and five consciousnesses; He declared the faculty of concentration in one hundred and four consciousnesses.

entries.work_title: 阿毗达摩入门-名色分别 Abhidhammāvatāro-Nāmarūpaparicchedo
entries.pali: Passaddhibahulo hutvā, samādhindriyalābhato; Tathevāppaṇihitena, niyyanto tividho bhave.
entries.chinese_simplified: 因获得定根而多于轻安；同样地，以无愿解脱而出离者，有三种。
entries.english: Having become one abounding in tranquility, through the acquisition of the faculty of concentration, just so, leading out by way of the desireless, one becomes threefold.

entries.work_title: 阿毗达摩入门-名色分别 Abhidhammāvatāro-Nāmarūpaparicchedo
entries.pali: Tassevamadhimuttassa, saddhā vā pana kevalā; Samādhindriyādhikā ca, vuṭṭhānaghaṭikā bhave.
entries.chinese_simplified: 对于如此胜解者，或唯有信，或信与增上的定根，即是出离之时机。
entries.english: For one who is thus resolved, faith, or even faith alone, along with the predominant faculty of concentration, becomes the condition for emergence.
